reason: Machine lens: the 13 removed pairs are LDA abs (zp_save+n, &BC02..&BC10, non-indexed, 4c, 3 bytes) + STA zp (3c, 2 bytes): 13 x 7 = 91 cycles, 13 x 5 = 65 bytes, no page-crossing or branch terms. SKIP 65 before the label (after the RTS, never executed) makes the kept &00/&01 restores and the tail from LDA zp_save+17 land exactly where they were (old label X: tail at X+75; new label X+65, 10 bytes, tail at X+75), so nothing after moves and the region size and its ASSERTs are unchanged. The only entry is render.6502's JMP restore_game_zp (absolute, the assembler retargets it); no label+N entries, no self-modifying writes into the routine, no code read as data. The removed instructions only affect A/N/Z, which the next LDA redefines. Spot-checked the semantic premise: no render-phase file (render*, sky*, kindcache*, scroll_hazel, compiled*, sprite_*, lib) stores to any of the 13 bytes by name or address (only &00/&01, still restored); drawing (&9B) is never set. All opcodes legal on the 65SC12.
